solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Coin gets man chicken sandwich for exercise class

indicators.note: to sandwich something is to hold it between two halves, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a cock is a male chicken
PE is physical education, a school exercise lesson

explanation.surface: A man buys a chicken sandwich to fuel himself for his workout class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'man' and 'chicken' are one piece together, a male bird; 'Coin' is the old Russian unit, also spelt kopeck.
explanation.definitionFit: A copeck is a small Russian coin, one hundredth of a rouble.

clue.text: Miner smuggles diamond in experimental technology

indicators.note: to smuggle is to carry something hidden within, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: a collier is a coal miner
D is the abbreviation for diamonds in card games

explanation.surface: A mine worker sneaks a gemstone out inside some new piece of research kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A particle collider, such as the Large Hadron Collider, is a large experimental physics machine.

clue.text: China ran police compound

indicators.note: compound means mixed together, so the letters of these words are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: In China, the police ran a fortified compound.
explanation.definitionFit: Porcelain is fine ceramic ware, commonly called china after the country where it was first made.

clue.text: Fixes, in Celsius, increases in temperature

parts.note: heats means makes or grows hotter

explanation.surface: A scientific report notes fixed points on the Celsius scale as the temperature rises.
explanation.definitionFit: To fix a contest or result is to rig it dishonestly, which is to cheat.

clue.text: State briefly described as satisfactory

parts.note: the US state whose postal abbreviation, OK, is also a word meaning acceptable or satisfactory

explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' means abbreviated: this state's two-letter code is OK, which also means satisfactory.
explanation.definitionFit: Oklahoma is a US state abbreviated OK, and OK also means acceptable.

clue.text: Wobbly, rickety engine has capacity to do work, when moving

definitions.text: capacity to do work, when moving

indicators.note: wobbly suggests something unsteady and shaken up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unstable, decrepit motor still manages to power the job while running.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics this is the energy a body has because of its motion, its ability to do work while moving.

clue.text: Wild drinkers got it out

indicators.note: out here means put out of order, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous, a group of former heavy drinkers

explanation.surface: Unruly drinkers managed to get it out of the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: AA (Alcoholics Anonymous) plus GOTIT are mixed by 'out' into the musical term.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitato is a musical direction meaning played in an agitated, restless way, so wild in spirit.

clue.text: In court, turn up mouldings

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the pieces are read from the bottom upwards, so backwards

parts.note: to see someone is to date or court them
a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: In a law court, decorative mouldings are turned upside down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses because this is a down clue; 'court' is the dating sense, as in seeing someone, not a law court.
explanation.definitionFit: An ogee is an S-shaped curved architectural moulding.

clue.text: Property in square owned by idiots

indicators.note: something owned by someone is held within their possession, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: asses are fools
a T-square is a drawing square, giving T

explanation.surface: A property in the town square belongs to some fools.
explanation.definitionFit: Assets are possessions or property of value.

clue.text: Bounty — not a ship like Titanic

indicators.note: not means without, so these letters are removed

parts.note: largess, also spelt with a final E, is generosity, bounty given freely
SS stands for steamship, used before ship names

explanation.surface: The Bounty was no ocean liner like the Titanic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bounty' and 'Titanic' look like ship names; Bounty is generosity, LARGESS, and 'titanic' means huge.
explanation.definitionFit: Titanic as an adjective means huge, so something like that is very big.

clue.text: Stars drawn around squares show optimism

indicators.note: drawn around means placed enclosing something, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: suns are stars
nine is a square number, three times three

explanation.surface: Stars drawn around squares on a chart signal a hopeful outlook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squares' is not geometry here but square numbers, of which nine is one.
explanation.definitionFit: A sunny disposition is cheerful and hopeful, so the quality is optimism.

clue.text: Flag display is currently the best, in theory

parts.note: a standard is a flag or banner
to model clothes is to display them

explanation.surface: A flag display is said to be the finest at the moment, at least theoretically.
explanation.definitionFit: The Standard Model is particle physics' best present theory of the fundamental particles and forces.

clue.text: Sloth, lion, ferret: rival characters every second

indicators.note: taking every second character means reading the alternate letters, starting with the second

explanation.surface: Sloth, lion and ferret are listed as competing animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloth is laziness, a resistance to action or effort, which inertia also means.

clue.text: Crossing from one pole to another tunnels through property

indicators.note: something that tunnels through goes inside, so one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: a trait is a characteristic or property
N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: An expedition crosses from pole to pole, burrowing through the land.
explanation.definitionFit: A transit is a passage across or through something, a crossing.

clue.text: Bounce email header over network

indicators.note: a header is at the top, so the first letter is taken

parts.note: a local area network, the kind linking computers in one office, is known by its three-letter abbreviation

explanation.surface: An email bounces back because of a fault over the network.
explanation.definitionFit: Bounce means lively energy or vigour, which is the sense of élan.

clue.text: They extract vitamin from professors?

indicators.note: here from means taken away from, so the letter is removed

parts.note: professors are educators
A is a vitamin, vitamin A

explanation.surface: A question whether professors extract vitamins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'They extract' reads as a sentence with 'from professors', but it is the definition: an eductor is a device that draws out fluid.
explanation.definitionFit: An eductor is a device that draws out or extracts fluid, as in a jet pump.

clue.text: You heard eel start ripping apart other marine creature

indicators.note: ripping apart breaks things up so the letters are reassembled
heard means said aloud, and the word you sounds like the letter U

parts.note: the pronoun you is pronounced like the letter U

explanation.surface: An eel begins tearing apart another sea animal, as you heard.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea turtle is a marine reptile, another sea creature besides the eel.

clue.text: Female ancestor's spliced into DNA of some Swiss people

indicators.note: splicing inserts one strand into another, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: a gene is a stretch of DNA, part of some of it
Eve is the first woman, ancestor of all, and the possessive gives her name with S

explanation.surface: A female ancestor's genetic material is spliced into some Swiss people's DNA.
explanation.definitionFit: The Genevese are the people of Geneva, a Swiss city.

clue.text: Subatomic particles built from junction in nerve cells

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: neurons are nerve cells
a T-junction gives T

explanation.surface: Subatomic particles are assembled from a junction in nerve cells.
explanation.definitionFit: Neutrons are uncharged particles found in the atomic nucleus.

clue.text: Part of endless witch-hunt is rescheduled

indicators.note: rescheduled means rearranged, so these letters are put in a new order
endless means without its ends, so the first and last letters go

explanation.surface: Part of an endless witch-hunt is postponed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' leaves ITCHHUN, which 'is rescheduled' rearranges. 'Part' looks like a noun but is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To part things is to separate them, as unhitching detaches a horse or trailer.

clue.text: Officer's winning move

definitions.meaning: a ship's officer below the captain, such as a first officer
in chess, the move that ends the game by trapping the king

explanation.surface: An officer has made the decisive move.
explanation.definitionFit: A mate is a merchant ship's officer, and checkmate, shortened, is the winning chess move.

clue.text: Tiniest thing fooled Reagan

parts.note: to have someone, or be had, is to be fooled
Ron is Ronald Reagan's short first name

explanation.surface: A tiny item fooled President Reagan.
explanation.definitionFit: A hadron is a subatomic particle such as a proton, among the smallest things in nature.

clue.text: One is positive in declaring opposition to BBC accent, on reflection

indicators.note: a reflection shows things reversed, so the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: saying no declares opposition
RP is Received Pronunciation, the traditional BBC accent

explanation.surface: Someone is sure of declaring against the BBC accent, after thinking it over.
explanation.definitionFit: A proton carries a positive electric charge.

clue.text: "Abracadabra! Hamburger slice," declared Isaac's dad

indicators.note: a slice is part of something, so the letters come from within these words

explanation.surface: A magician says the magic word and conjures up a slice of hamburger.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Abraham is the father of Isaac.

clue.text: Publish no conclusion in liver transplant

indicators.note: no means without, so the letter is removed

parts.note: to report news is to publish it

indicators.note: the conclusion of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: No final word is published on the liver transplant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'liver transplant' reads as surgery, but 'transplant' alone is the definition, moving a plant to a new pot.
explanation.definitionFit: To repot a plant is to transplant it into a different pot.

clue.text: Divert right during journey, but not North

indicators.note: but not means without, so the letter is removed

parts.note: en route means on the way, during a journey

explanation.surface: A driver diverts right partway through the trip, but not to the north.
explanation.definitionFit: To divert traffic is to send it on a different course.

clue.text: Play duet in comeback, presumably

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a comeback is a reply or retort

indicators.note: play suggests the letters are played with and rearranged

explanation.surface: Performing a duet during a comeback concert, supposedly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Play' rearranges DUET into UTED, which goes 'in' REPLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Reputedly means according to what is generally said, so supposedly or presumably.

clue.text: The strength of a solution is nearer being announced

indicators.note: announced means spoken aloud, so the word is given by its sound

parts.note: tighter means closer or nearer, as in a tight finish

explanation.surface: A chemist says how strong a solution is getting nearer to the target.
explanation.definitionFit: A titre is the measured concentration of a solution, found by titration.

clue.text: Briefly, in one of these is punishment for teachers

parts.note: the NUT was the National Union of Teachers, a British teaching union
hell is a place of punishment

explanation.surface: In short, the punishment is meant for teachers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a nutshell' means briefly; NUT is the National Union of Teachers, a British union.
explanation.definitionFit: To put something in a nutshell is to state it briefly.

clue.text: Dwell in this place

parts.note: here means in this place

explanation.surface: A request to live in this place.
explanation.definitionFit: To inhere is to exist in something as a permanent quality, to dwell within.
